title: Account Assistant - Temp
description:
Finance Reconciliation Officer

Temporary Contract Finance Department

Reporting to: Bursar
Department: Finance
Contract Type: Temporary

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Reconciliation Officer to support the Finance Department in an Independent School on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional with strong Sage Accounting and advanced Excel skills who can confidently reconcile supplier and customer accounts, investigate discrepancies, and provide accurate financial reporting.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring financial records are accurate, fully supported, and presented clearly to the Bursar.

Key Responsibilities
- Reconcile supplier and customer accounts, ensuring balances are accurate and up to date.
- Review and investigate historical discrepancies, missing transactions, and outstanding balances.
- Collect and organise supporting documentation, including invoices, statements, payments, and credit notes.
- Identify and resolve aged balances, duplicate transactions, and unapplied payments.
- Use Sage Accounting to review transactions, analyse account balances, and extract reports.
- Prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and reports using Excel.
- Maintain accurate and organised audit trails for all reconciliations.
- Present findings and recommendations clearly to the Bursar.
- Escalate significant issues with proposed solutions where appropriate.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Strong practical experience using Sage Accounting Software.
- Advanced Excel skills, including:
- Pivot Tables
- VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
- SUMIFS
- Data analysis and reporting
- Proven experience reconciling supplier and customer accounts.
- Strong understanding of:
- Purchase Ledger
- Sales Ledger
- Payments
- Credit Notes
- Account Balances
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financial information clearly.

Key Deliverables
- Fully reconciled supplier and customer account balances.
- Complete supporting documentation for all reconciliations.
- Clear records of discrepancies identified and actions taken.
- Summary reconciliation reports for the Bursar.
- Accurate financial records supported by a robust audit trail.

Apply Now

If you have strong Sage and Excel skills, excellent reconciliation experience, and enjoy resolving complex accounting discrepancies, we would like to hear from you.

Contact Muzna Naqvi at Reed Reading Office for more details

title: Accounts Payable & Account Receivable Specialiist
description:
Morson are recruiting on behalf of an Aerospace company based in Reading that designs and develops the next-generation sixth-generation combat aircraft for the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP).

The Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Specialist will join the team at a critical time in the GCAP programme, the standing up and fast growth of the Joint Venture. This is a rare opportunity to have a long-term impact on the success of the JV, by playing a crucial role in the initial stages of the life of the new organisation and laying the foundations for its success through carrying out the sound transactional financial services and inputting into the design of the function.

This position is critical for the company and will be a member of the team responsible for the operation of the Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) function ensuring the accuracy of the company's accounts and maintaining the company's assets and liabilities.

You will contribute to the smooth operation of accounting processes through daily management of incoming and outgoing invoices, proposing and running payment runs, performing reconciliation of the subledgers and supplier statements, and collaboration with relevant stakeholders through monthly Aged Creditor/Debtor reviews and GRNI reviews.
This role will report into the Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Manager.

Key Accountabilities;
Accounts Payable Related Duties;
- Accurately and timely posting of payable invoices entries relating to Accounts Payable, accrued expenses, and prepaid expenses.
- Reconcile AP Subledger balances with invoices received from supplier.
- Verify appropriateness of payments through reconciling invoices, Good Receipts, and Purchase Orders (3-way matching) and managing and resolving GRNI exceptions through Aged GRNI Reviews.
- Prepare payment schedules aligned with due dates and create bank transfer data working together with Treasury team.
- Review and process Non PO and Ad-hoc payments
- Managed aged and blocked invoices through organising and chairing of Aged Creditor Reviews.

Accounts Receivable Related Duties;
- Confirm incoming money in bank accounts and perform Cash allocations (application/matching) against billing data
- Identify overdue receivables and collaborate with Sales team to promote collection
- Conduct AR balance confirmation procedures with customers, especially at period-end

Other General Duties;
- Support month-end and year-end closing processes, including verifying AP/AR account balances, conducting account analysis, and preparing audit documentation
- Propose and implement improvements to accounting processes through digitalisation, automation, and governance and internal control enhancements
- Supplier and customer query handling and management, ensuring a positive relationship with all stakeholders and supporting the Treasury team with cashflow forecasting

Qualifications;
- The jobholder will possess strong curiosity about figures
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills with the ability to liaise confidently with internal and external stakeholders
- Flexible to changes and proactive in pursuing business process improvements
- Practical experience in either AP, AR, or both and
basic bookkeeping knowledge
- PC proficiency in Excel
- Experience using ERP system such as SAP would be an advantage
- Have an ability to collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues of various backgrounds, relaying financial concepts in a simple and understandable manner
- Language proficiency in Japanese or Italian would be an advantage.

This is an excellent opportunity to join the business at an exciting time.

Morson is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Accounts assistant; accounts payable, accounts receivable; purchase ledger; sales ledger; SAP; SAGE; AAT; payroll; VAT returns; reconciliation; credit control; Japanese; Italian

- Business Operations & HR Support: Support HR and administrative activities, including employee record-keeping, recruitment coordination, document preparation, and coordination across business functions.

Key Requirements
- A degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related subject would be advantageous.
- An AAT Level 2 qualification, or willingness to work towards one, would be beneficial.
- Strong English and Maths skills, ideally with GCSE grades of 6 or above.
- A hardworking, reliable attitude and a genuine willingness to learn.
- An interest in developing a long-term career in finance and business operations.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues, customers, and suppliers.

Career Development

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their career to gain practical experience across core finance functions, particularly sales and purchase ledger, credit control, and business operations. With training, experience, and continued development, there is potential to progress into a more senior finance position or management role in the future.

To apply for this Junior Finance & Business Operations Assistant role based in Aldermaston, Berkshire, please send your CV to (url removed) or call (phone number removed).

title: Part-Time Finance Administrator
description:

title: Purchase Ledger Assistant
description:

An established organisation is seeking a detail-oriented Purchase Ledger Assistant to join its Finance team. This role plays a key part in ensuring supplier invoices, subcontractor payments, reconciliations, and financial records are processed accurately and efficiently.

- Monitor and resolve debit balance issues
- Ensure all processing complies with internal controls and company policies
- Respond to supplier and internal stakeholder queries efficiently and professionally

- Provide support and cover for colleagues during periods of absence
- Assist with ad hoc finance projects and additional duties as required

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous Purchase Ledger / Accounts Payable experience
- Experience working in a high-volume processing environment
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to meet deadlines
- A proactive and team-focused approach
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- A commitment to maintaining high standards and delivering quality work

What We're Looking For
- Someone who enjoys working as part of a collaborative team
- The ability to follow established procedures and controls
- A positive, flexible attitude and willingness to support colleagues
- A commitment to getting things right first time

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Purchase Ledger professional looking to join a busy finance function where accuracy, teamwork, and continuous improvement are highly valued

title: Purchase Ledger Controller
description:
Purchase Ledger Controller

Salary: £30,000-£35,000

Location: Finchampstead, Wokingham

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.30am-5.30pm

Working Arrangements: Office-based initially, with up to two days working from home after probation.

About the Client

Our client is a well-established organisation operating within the Logistics / Distribution / Supply Chain sector, supporting a broad customer base across the UK. They offer a friendly, supportive working environment where teamwork, accuracy and professional development are valued.

About the Job

An excellent opportunity to join a busy finance team of five, managing high-volume purchase ledger transactions. The role involves detailed invoice matching across multiple purchase orders, making exceptional attention to detail essential.

Duties will include:
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices and credit notes.
- Accurately matching complex, multi-line invoices against purchase orders.
- Investigating discrepancies and resolving supplier queries.
- Preparing payment runs and reconciling supplier accounts.
- Maintaining short-term cash flow records.
- Using Excel and accounting systems to support accurate financial processing.

About the Successful Applicant

You will be numerically confident, highly organised and exceptionally accurate. Ideally, you will have one to two years' purchase ledger or accounts payable experience, although bright, quick learners will also be considered. Excel skills and an interest in pursuing accounting qualifications would be beneficial. Please include academic qualifications and grades on your CV.

What You Will Receive in Return

A salary of £30,000-£35,000, potential hybrid working after probation and the opportunity to develop your accounting career within a supportive, established finance team.

title: Temporary Payroll Administrator
description:
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Payroll Administrator to support an established business in Maidenhead on a short term, ad hoc basis.

The immediate requirement is to process a small monthly payroll. The assignment is expected to require around two days each month for an initial three-month period.

This position would suit someone looking to add a small, regular assignment alongside other work. The successful candidate will need to be available around the monthly payroll timetable, with exact dates to be agreed.

£18.00-£20.00 per hour, depending on experience.

There may be scope to assist with additional finance duties depending on experience and availability.

Responsibilities:
- Process the monthly payroll accurately and within the required deadlines
- Check employee information, pay changes, deductions and other payroll data
- Complete the necessary HMRC payroll reporting and submissions
- Manage PAYE and National Insurance requirements
- Assist with monthly pension administration and submissions
- Check payroll reports and resolve any discrepancies
- Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records
- Respond to payroll related queries
- Assist with employee expenses and benefits reporting where required
- Liaise with the wider finance and management team as needed

Experience required:
- Recent hands on experience processing UK payroll
- Good knowledge of PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and HMRC payroll requirements
- Experience using payroll software, with Sage or Xero experience advantageous
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- Confidence managing a small payroll independently
- A discreet and professional approach when handling confidential information
- The ability to meet fixed monthly deadlines
- Availability to commit to approximately two days per month for an initial three-month period
